summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) filed a Form 6-K reporting the board's approval of a CEO succession: Mario Roberto Opice Leão was exonerated as CEO and resigned from the board and Innovation Committee, effective June 30, 2026. Gilson Finkelsztain was confirmed as the new CEO, effective July 1, 2026. The change follows a succession plan disclosed on March 19, 2026. No financial terms, premium, or advisor were mentioned. This is a permanent managerial transition, not a routine meeting. What to watch: executive continuity and any strategic shifts under new leadership.
